nodes.description: BotProtected.owner: privileged address set in ConvergenceToken constructor from msg.sender
BotProtected.botProtection: externally supplied anti-bot contract address invoked by checkBots
BotProtected.uniPair: Uniswap pair address computed in constructor and passed to the anti-bot check
ConvergenceToken.balanceOf: public mapping of token balances written without SafeMath
ConvergenceToken.allowance: public nested mapping of spender allowances
ConvergenceToken.totalSupply: fixed initial supply constant value
ConvergenceToken.uniRouter: Uniswap V2 router interface instance used by list()
ConvergenceToken.wETH: wrapped ETH address used to compute the pair in the constructor
ERC20._balances: private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 implementation
ERC20._allowances: private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 implementation
ERC20._totalSupply: private total supply of the abstract ERC20 implementation
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for ownership checks, approvals and transfers
block.timestamp: miner controllable value used to build the Uniswap deadline in list()
BotProtected constructor: stores the anti-bot protection contract address
checkBots modifier: performs an untyped low-level call into botProtection before the guarded body executes
ConvergenceToken constructor: sets owner, computes uniPair and pre-approves router and pair
ConvergenceToken.transfer: payable wrapper that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
ConvergenceToken.transferFrom: checkBots guarded transfer performing raw unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic
ConvergenceToken.approve: sets the caller allowance for a spender
ConvergenceToken.delegate: owner-only delegatecall into an arbitrary user supplied address and payload
pairFor: pure helper computing the Uniswap V2 pair address from two tokens
list: owner-only liquidity listing function that calls the Uniswap router and airdrops balances in a loop
ERC20.transfer: SafeMath based transfer of the abstract ERC20 contract
ERC20.transferFrom: SafeMath based transferFrom of the abstract ERC20 contract
ERC20._transfer: internal balance bookkeeping using SafeMath
ERC20._approve: internal allowance writer with zero address checks
SafeMath.add: overflow checked addition
SafeMath.sub: underflow checked subtraction
SafeMath.mul: overflow checked multiplication
SafeMath.div: division by zero checked division
ERC20._mint: internal supply and balance increase using SafeMath
ERC20._burn: internal supply and balance decrease using SafeMath
delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata inside delegate(), executing foreign code in the token storage context
Unchecked low-level call with hardcoded selector into the untrusted botProtection contract inside checkBots
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value (arithmetic underflow risk on Solidity 0.7)
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value (arithmetic overflow risk on Solidity 0.7)
block.timestamp + 600 used as the Uniswap swap deadline in list()
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with no SafeMath guard
_botProtection parameter of the BotProtected constructor
_botProtection parameter forwarded by the ConvergenceToken constructor
_from parameter of ConvergenceToken.transferFrom
_to parameter of ConvergenceToken.transferFrom
_value parameter of ConvergenceToken.transferFrom
_spender parameter of ConvergenceToken.approve
_value parameter of ConvergenceToken.approve
a parameter (target address) of delegate()
b parameter (calldata) of delegate()
tokenA parameter of pairFor
tokenB parameter of pairFor
_numList parameter of list(): token amount used for liquidity
_tos parameter of list(): recipient array of the airdrop loop
_amounts parameter of list(): amount array of the airdrop loop
i loop index of the airdrop loop in list()
notABot boolean returned by the botProtection low-level call and used in require
isNotBot bytes returned by the botProtection low-level call (unused)
